Title: Hydroponic Mint: pH, EC, Cuttings & Harvest Guide
Description: Grow hydroponic mint from cuttings at pH 5.5–6.5 and EC 1.4–2.5. First cut 3–7 weeks after transplant, then regrow and cut every 30–46 days. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
Keywords: hydroponic mint, hydroponics, indoor gardening, grow vegetables indoors
